elements.label: Full-frame scene swap: night rooftop ghost-blaster to sunlit desert shield fight
elements.change_other: scene replacement under a burst of diagonal light-ray / dust streaks with motion blur

sfx_review.label: unsure
sfx_review.note: Broadband low-end transient ~330 ms before the visual swap, while the rooftop scene is still on screen; looks more like a music hit than a reversed swoosh, but cannot separate it from the score.

pattern.description: Within one detected shot the footage jumps from a dark rooftop mixed-reality game to a bright desert game; the change is masked by diagonal light rays and dust streaks with heavy directional motion blur that continue over the new scene.
pattern.why_premium: The swap is hidden inside an in-world energy/light burst that matches the action (blaster fire into a shield swing), so the cut feels like a continuous motion beat timed to the 'from the left' narration rather than an edit.

build_hint.gsap: Stack scene A and scene B; overlay a light-streak layer. tl.fromTo('.streaks',{opacity:0,xPercent:-20},{opacity:1,xPercent:0,duration:0.1,ease:'power3.out'}).set('.sceneA',{autoAlpha:0}).fromTo('.sceneB',{filter:'blur(12px) brightness(1.4)'},{filter:'blur(0px) brightness(1)',duration:0.4,ease:'power2.out'}).to('.streaks',{opacity:0,duration:0.5,ease:'power1.in'});
build_hint.remotion: Two <Sequence> clips with a hard switch at the burst frame; streak overlay opacity interpolate(frame,[0,3,15],[0,1,0]); scene B filter blur/brightness interpolated with Easing.out(Easing.cubic). No spring.

notes: Probably a missed shot boundary (scene changes completely between f500 and f503 though the event sits in shot s012). camera.move is none; pan/scale values reflect content change, not a camera move.
